$comment: Reviewed manifest of every media file the web build ships (AGENTS.md #8: all asset reuse must be licensed and attributed).
scripts/audit-assets.mjs fails when a media file in dist/ matches no entry, matches more than one, or when an entry's licence file is missing or does not name its licence.
pattern: regular expression tested against the file's base name in dist/ (bundler content hashes vary, so match [\w-]+ for the hash).

source: the npm package the file comes from; "in-repo" for an asset authored in this repository; or "third-party:<provider>" for a third-party file committed to this repository (its licence text lives in LICENSES/).
licence: SPDX id; must be one of the ids reviewed in the script's LICENCE_EXPECTATIONS table.
licenceFile: path relative to apps/web. npm sources must point into node_modules/<source>/; in-repo sources must point outside node_modules.
attribution: the credit the project publishes for the asset; keep it consistent with README.md 'Credits and licences'.

Derived from a real build: the files below are exactly the Fontsource subsets imported in src/main.tsx (latin 400 and 600 for IBM Plex Mono, latin 400, 500 and 700 for IBM Plex Sans, latin 400, 600 and 700 for IBM Plex Sans Condensed, and latin 400 normal and italic for Newsreader), each emitted as .woff and .woff2.

In-repo brand files: public/ files are copied unhashed, so their patterns are exact file names. scripts/brand-assets.mjs draws them. They are original art under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSING.md); the licence text is LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt. The UNHELD name and mark as the project's identity are reserved by LICENSING.md.
